zh-CN.title: 更从容的音乐播放体验
items: 音乐播放器重新排版，歌词独立滚动，播放控制始终可见，适配手机与桌面窗口。
卡片与悬浮播放器共用详情页，新增前后跳转十秒，歌词跟随更平稳。

en.title: A calmer music player
items: A refined layout keeps playback controls visible while lyrics scroll independently on phones and desktops.
Cards and the floating player now share one detail view, with ten-second seeking and smoother lyric following.
